subtitle: An opinionated architecture for building and shipping better apps in the agentic age.
promise: Your agents can build any app. If they follow CARLOS principles, they come out better.
architecture_copy: CARLOS, at its root, is a set of hard decisions that you no longer need to make about things you shouldn't have to care about.
By accepting these decisions, you get fast, robust, accessible applications that can be deployed locally, or to any cloud on any platform, and run for 70–80% less than traditional apps.
Use Rastrillo to build apps that embody the CARLOS architecture, and use CARLOS platform (self-hosted, or via Carloku) to deploy them today.
